oral_examination.oral_examination: 338 The mesial and low-lying impaction is covered by the gums. There is no abnormal color, no redness, swelling, or congestion. Nothing special.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: 38. Local povidone-iodine disinfection, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride, and infiltration anesthesia with bistriol around the wisdom teeth. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are incised, the flaps are flapped, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch and scrape the tooth extraction wound, and apply pressure and sutures to stop bleeding.
